'''''Dyckia brevifolia''''', or '''sawblade''', is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Bromeliaceae]] family.<ref>{{cite web
 |url= https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:122693-1
 |title= Dyckia brevifolia Baker
 |author=<!--Not stated-->
 |date=n.d.
 |website=Plants of the World Online
 |publisher=The Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew
 |access-date=July 18, 2020}}</ref> This species is [[Endemism|endemic]] to [[Brazil]].

==Cultivars==
[[Dyckia 'Yellow Glow'|''Dyckia'' 'Yellow Glow']] is a cultivar of ''Dyckia brevifolia''. ''Dyckia brevifolia'' is also one parent of the hybrid cultivars ''Dyckia'' 'Lad Cutak', ''Dyckia'' 'Naked Lady' and ''Dyckia'' 'Vista'.
